Lets talk about turning our foundation into a VLM agent that's able to answer questions about the video streams. I want to be able to ask questions like:
- how many white ford trucks were there between 2-3pm? and get a structured response back. We will store these detections along with their timestamps in a proper database, maybe vector store and this is just running in the background on the video in real time. At some point the user will prompt the deepagent and as the question. Maybe there's emergent tagging here that will be discovered). The agent should then perhaps spawn other role specific agents on the grouping of frames around what it thinks are the trucks and maybe the agent it creates is a "truck color" agent whos only job is to confirm (using a proper VLM) that the object detected is a truck and its white. It would report back to the "reporter" agent and say, yup, heres one and the time. The reporter has special instructions to make sure the details are formatted in some structure and what to do with it. In the end the main agent will be able to have validated and send back the response that there were "x white trucks between 2-3pm"... The key to this whole system is that the main deep agent will be in charge of building its own agents. What we are going to provide is a clear structure, tools, and framework for doing this.
